scope: Third evidence batch, continuing compulsory requirements only.

evidence.supports: Rotter's internal/external locus of control is directly covered in an accepted CC BY source.
evidence.remaining: Resistance through social support still needs explicit reusable evidence, and the locus material must be connected carefully to resistance rather than merely personality.

evidence.supports: Baddeley and Hitch working-memory model, central executive, phonological loop, visuospatial sketchpad and episodic buffer, including limited working-memory capacity.
evidence.remaining: Foundation transformation and exact AQA coding/capacity emphasis.

evidence.supports: Statistical infrequency/deviance, social and cultural norms, dysfunction and impairment are explicitly treated in accepted CC BY Lumen material.
evidence.remaining: Deviation from ideal mental health needs a separate explicit reusable source.

evidence.supports: Core phobia, major-depression and OCD symptoms are covered across accepted CC BY sources, including fear/avoidance, mood/cognitive changes, obsessions and compulsions.
evidence.remaining: Revision transformation should explicitly organise the source-backed material into AQA's behavioural/emotional/cognitive categories.

evidence.supports: Beck's negative self/world/future pattern, Ellis/ABC-style cognitive model and CBT challenging dysfunctional or irrational thoughts.
OCD genetic evidence, neural/circuit explanations and medication treatment including serotonin-reuptake approaches are directly covered by accepted CC BY material.
evidence.remaining: Foundation transformation and AQA terminology alignment only.

evidence.supports: Cognitive psychology as the study of internal thinking processes and schema as a mental construct for organising/interpreting information.
evidence.remaining: The AQA emphasis on theoretical/computer models and inference from behaviour needs more explicit reusable evidence.

evidence.supports: Genotype/phenotype, evolution, nervous-system structures, neurotransmission/neurochemistry and biological/neuroscience approaches to behaviour are covered across accepted CC BY sources.
evidence.remaining: Foundation transformation should make the cognitive-neuroscience link explicit.

evidence.supports: Central and peripheral nervous systems plus somatic and autonomic subdivisions are directly covered.
Sensory and motor neurons, action potentials, synaptic transmission, neurotransmitters, receptors and reuptake are directly covered.
evidence.remaining: AQA relay-neuron terminology plus explicit excitation/inhibition treatment need named-source confirmation.

evidence.supports: fMRI, EEG and post-mortem examination are directly covered in the accepted CC BY neuroscience textbook, with uses and limitations.
evidence.remaining: Event-related potentials (ERPs) are not yet adequately covered by an accepted source in the registered corpus.
